sh.title: Seasonal home
sh.sub: Save home-page looks for your seasons (Eid, Puja, winter) and schedule each one. The home page switches by itself at the start and comes back at the end.
sh.note: Only the home page's sections, hero words and hero pictures change. Prices, offers and the checkout never change, and no money is spent. After a window ends, the home page is your own home page again by itself.
sh.offBody: Turn it on in the settings card at the bottom of this page.
sh.offAsk: Ask the owner or a manager to turn Seasonal home on.

now.usual: Your usual home page. No seasonal look is showing.

win.clock: Times are on your shop's clock ({tz}).
win.endsHelp: Leave the end empty to keep the look until you stop it. Two windows may not overlap.

looks.empty: No looks yet. Save the home page as it is now, then change it for the season.

save.h: Save the home page as it is now
save.name: Name of the look
save.help: Keeps a copy of your home page's settings now. Change the copy for the season; your live home page stays as it is.
save.saved: Saved. Open “Change this look” to make it seasonal.

edit.name: Name
edit.sectionsHelp: Tick the sections to show; move them up or down. A section with nothing to show stays hidden by itself.
edit.eyebrow: Hero: small line above the title
edit.title: Hero: title
edit.lineHelp: Write each line in both languages, or leave both boxes empty for the usual words.
edit.collHelp: Pick a collection (for example your Eid collection) to slide its products in the hero, inside the collection's own dates.

err.SWITCHED_OFF: Seasonal home is off. Turn it on first.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found any more: {fields}. Reload the page.
err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. Reload the page.
err.OVERLAP: This window overlaps another scheduled window. Pick other times or stop the other one.
err.IN_USE: This look is scheduled. Stop its window first.
err.ENDED: This window has already ended or was stopped.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission for this.

card.d: Seasonal home switching. Off as it ships.
card.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
card.onHelp: On: scheduled looks show on the home page inside their windows. Off: the home page is always your usual one, and nothing new can be scheduled.
